गृह्य {%a.%} .²1 To be taken or received. .²2 To be sized. .²3 To be observed, perceptible, perceivable. .²4 To be acknowledged or admitted. .²5 To be trusted or relied on; to be honoured. .²6 Taking the side of, adopting or choosing as best. .²7 Dependent, subservient. .{@-ह्यः@} The anus.
